newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Sales of 82,400 MT were down 27 percent from the previous week and 1 percent below the 4-week average. The buyers were Japan (63,000 MT), Mexico (15,200 MT), and Israel (4,200 MT).

Exports of 65,600 MT declined two-thirds from the prior week's marketing-year high and were one-half below the 4-week average. The destinations were Japan (33,200 MT), Israel (26,200 MT), and Mexico (6,100 MT).
